search_text: published ZDI-24-067 ZDI-CAN-22544 Ivanti Avalanche WLAvalancheService Divide By Zero Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2024-01-11 CVE-2023-46803 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-46803 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Ivanti'] ['Avalanche'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WLAvalancheService. title: Ivanti Avalanche WLAvalancheService Divide By Zero Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WLAvalancheService. The issue results from the lack of proper exception handling when performing an integer division operation. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
